caveats: targetMaxHpPct grants (skill2 44.98%, burst 20.14%) read 'of the skill user's Max HP' (CASTER-scaled), but targetMaxHpPct scales by the TARGET's own Max HP — semantic mismatch. Kept for kit completeness; offensively INERT either way (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct — e3 rule), so the mismatch moves no damage. If a casterMaxHpPct stat exists, prefer it.
